column1: # --- serangan & Taryz ---
=Selects an enemy target and summons <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> to follow it.
column2: Memilih target musuh lalu memanggil <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> untuk mengikutinya.

column1: =Selects an enemy target within <color=#f26c1c>9 tiles</color> and summons <color=#3487e0>{8}</color> to follow it for <color=#f26c1c>3 rounds</color>.
column2: Memilih target musuh <color=#f26c1c>dalam 9 tile</color> lalu memanggil <color=#3487e0>{8}</color> untuk mengikutinya selama <color=#f26c1c>3 ronde</color>.

column1: =When the target that <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> is following dies, Taryz switches to following the enemy unit with the current highest HP.

column1: =Cleanses <color=#f26c1c>2</color> debuffs and applies <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> to all allied units, lasting for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
